verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that mandataires (agents) exist as filers and that a mandataire can delegate payment to a client. It also documents a qualified e-signature requirement for filing. None of it publishes what a third party may or may not do on a principal's behalf: there are no authorization or mandate forms, no role definitions, and no statement of which signatures must remain personal. Payment delegation and the general signing rule are adjacent features, not a published delegation scope.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
